about: MANZZA Industry Pvt. Ltd. is a Bengaluru manufacturer of transformer core laminations. We cut, punch and prepare CRGO and CRNO electrical steel to our customers' drawings: mitre step-lap laminations, E&I laminations and strip laminations. We supply transformer manufacturers across Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana and Tamil Nadu, and we keep to one job: transformer core laminations, made to drawing.

intro.opening: Every transformer starts as a sheet of steel.

process.text: Automated CNC cutting to the dimensions and angles on your drawing, with shearing and supporting operations.
Punching and hole processing for holes, slots and E&I profiles.
Mitre laminations prepared in step-lap sequence, so the joint moves along with each layer.
Core stacking support: laminations sorted and packets built to your design.
